title: sparkxray findings
description: What one analysis of a Spark run found: the rules it ran with the thresholds each applied, its findings, from the most wall time a fix could recover to the least, and the rules it skipped because the input lacked a signal they read. sparkxray findings list --json prints it, with gate, and findings show --json prints one item of findings. findings.parquet keeps this document without findings in its key-value metadata, under sparkxray.analysis. A field removed or a meaning changed raises schema_version, and a field added does not.

app_id.description: The application analyzed. Null for a plan analyzed alone, with no log.

signals.description: What the analyzed input held. A rule reading anything else is in skipped.

rules_run.description: Every rule that ran, found something or not, with the thresholds it applied. So a rule an override silenced reads as silenced, not as clean.

findings.description: Ordered by impact_seconds, largest first and null last, then by severity, then by finding_id.

gate.description: Present where the analysis was judged against a severity bar, as sparkxray findings list --fail-on judges it. It passes when no finding is at or above fail_on, and blocking names those that are, whether or not findings lists them.

signal.description: plan: a physical plan. plan_metrics: its nodes' measured metrics. plan_stages: which stages ran each node, which a log rebuilt from REST JSON lacks. whole_run: every job, stage, SQL execution and task of the run, which a server past its spark.ui.retained* limits had dropped part of. plan_estimates: the optimizer's size estimates, which only explain(mode='cost') text prints and no event log carries. tasks: task metrics. executors: executor lifetimes and sizes. environment: the run's configuration. timeline: when stages ran. glue_metrics: Glue's observability metrics for the run, read from CloudWatch. glue_insights: Glue's job run insights for a failed run, read from CloudWatch Logs. driver_log: records of Spark's structured logging, read from the logs given.

schema_version.description: The version of this shape. A field removed or a meaning changed raises it, and a field added does not.

finding_id.description: The rule id and a key naming the scope: app for the application, e0 for execution 0, e0n9 for its plan node 9, s4 for stage 4, x3 for executor 3. A plan analyzed alone with no execution id is plan, and its node 9 is n9. Analyzing the same log again gives the same ids.

rule_id.description: The rule that found it, as rules list names it.

rule_version.description: Rises whenever what the rule reports changes.

severity.description: base_severity moved one step by the scope's share of the application's wall time: down below 5%, up above 50%. info never moves, and nothing drops below low.

title.description: One line saying what was found, with its numbers.

evidence.description: What the rule measured. A numeric value's key ends in its unit. stage_wall_share or sql_execution_wall_share is the scope's share of the application's wall time, which moved severity.

thresholds.description: Every threshold of the rule, by name, with the value this finding was judged against.

impact_seconds.description: The wall time a fix could recover. Null where no one can say, as for a rule reading only the plan.

confidence.description: How sure the rule is that the measurement shows the problem it names.

remediation.description: What to try, in the order to try it.

docs.description: Pages that explain the problem and its fixes.

scope.description: The ids of what the finding is about. An id that does not apply is null.

app_id.description: The application the finding is about. Null for a plan analyzed alone.

sql_execution_id.description: The SQL execution it is about.

plan_node_id.description: The node's number in the execution's last plan, as plan_nodes numbers it.

plan_node_label.description: The line Spark printed for that node.

stage_attempt.description: The attempt of that stage it measured.

worst_task_ids.description: The tasks that show the finding most, worst first.

source.description: The layer that set value: the rule's default, a thresholds file, the SDK's thresholds mapping, or a <rule_id>.<name>=<value> override string. A later layer in that list overrides an earlier one.

default_source.description: Where the rule's own value comes from.

reported.description: False for a rule that ran only because a selected rule reads its findings. Its findings reached that rule alone, so they are not in findings, and the gate does not judge them.
